question: In a certain code language, 'TYPE' is written as 'SXOD'. How will 'SING' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7fd46426f00ba56b91d423458faa673503496b14e50413ec14eae6a6e84c211.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

'TYPE' is written as 'SXOD'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b58a2a184952d2122edea7edd8bc613c4f91db1c955c47bf6f427e6281999b1d.png] 

Similarly,

'SING' will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/09afc0666dbc91f2ddcd742d61693f89c7f7861a8c98b9cdabdb999756256748.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"RHMF".**
